claims.text: The funding is for research to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society.
The 2026 priority theme is inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in a racially diverse UK.
There is one deadline a year for this fund, in the Autumn.

records.justification: The agent's text accurately reflects the purpose, amount, and some eligibility criteria of the funding opportunity, but it incorrectly states the next round's opening date, which is not mentioned in the provided page text.

claims.text: The funding opportunity supports original and ambitious research projects.
The projects should address the UK's social and economic challenges.
Projects must address one or more of the five priority questions.
The next round of funding is likely to open in the first half of 2027.
Up to £15 million is available in total.
Grants are typically in the range of £1-3 million each.
The fund supports new, transformative ideas.
The fund supports multidisciplinary work.
The fund supports experimental and innovative approaches.
The aim is to improve people's lives in the UK.
Proposals must be relevant to at least one of the priority questions.
Proposals must demonstrate a clear path to making a difference to people's lives.
Research methodology must be appropriate and rigorous.
Proposals should incorporate multidisciplinary perspectives.
The project team must have appropriate experience, expertise, and capacity.
The requested budget must be appropriate and offer good value for money.
Individuals without formal employment or institutional affiliation will not be funded.
Projects led by individuals unaffiliated to any organization will not be funded.
Projects led by undergraduates or master's students will not be funded.
PhD fees or projects primarily supporting a PhD will not be funded.
The establishment of academic posts will not be funded.
Ongoing costs or costs of rolling out existing work/services will not be funded.
A one-page summary of the proposal can be sent to strategicfund@nuffieldfoundation.org to check potential fit.
Summaries will only be reviewed and responded to if submitted prior to February 1st, 2026.

records.justification: The agent's text captures most of the eligibility criteria but omits details about the types of UK-based organisations, the duration of affiliation, and the requirement for research impact.

claims.text: Applicants must be employed by or have a formal affiliation with a UK-based organisation.
The UK-based organisation must be a university, research organisation, or voluntary sector body.
The affiliation must be for at least the duration of the project.
Unaffiliated individuals are excluded.
Projects led by schools or FE colleges are excluded.
Undergraduates or master's students are excluded.
PhD-fee projects are excluded.
Establishment of academic posts is excluded.
Non-UK-led organisations are excluded, except in exceptional cases where no UK-based host is feasible.
There must be a clear path to how the research and related activities might make a difference to people’s lives.
